intro: Every family below is the same MDP. They differ in three answers: where the reward comes from, where the training data comes from, and how many steps pass before the reward arrives.

families.name: Classical RL
families.data: fresh rollouts, or a replay buffer
families.takeaway: env → state → reward → next state. That loop.

families.name: RLHF
families.reward: people compare two outputs; a reward model learns from that (DPO keeps it implicit)
families.data: fresh samples (PPO), or a fixed preference set (DPO)

groups.title: + PPO
items: InstructGPT, with KL to the reference

groups.title: over-optimization
items: the RM gets gamed; KL limits it

families.takeaway: A learned reward stands in for the environment.

families.name: RLAIF
families.reward: an LLM judge, or a written constitution
families.data: fresh samples, or a fixed set the judge labelled

groups.title: LLM-as-judge
items: pairwise scoring; watch for its biases

families.takeaway: Replace the human labeler with an AI.

families.name: RLVR and reasoning
families.reward: a program that checks the answer
families.steps: one response, often a long one

groups.title: DeepSeek-R1
items: R1-Zero: pure RL on a base model

groups.title: o1-style scaling
items: RL on chain-of-thought, plus inference compute

groups.title: code: run the tests
items: CodeRL (tests as reward), AlphaCode (tests as filter)

families.takeaway: No learned reward model: a verifier is the reward.

families.name: Agentic RL
families.reward: whether the task got done, often checked by tests

groups.title: scaffold
items: ReAct, Toolformer; RL fine-tunes inside it

families.takeaway: Long horizons make credit assignment hard.

families.name: Offline RL
families.data: a fixed dataset; nothing new is collected

groups.title: policy constraints
items: BCQ, BEAR: stay near the data

groups.title: implicit Q
items: IQL: never query actions outside the data

families.takeaway: DPO is offline RL on preference data.

bridge.text: Iterate it on-policy: online and iterative preference optimization bridges offline DPO and online PPO/GRPO.
